$comment: Shared header for the split taxonomy. schemas/analytics/*.json are merged ALL-OR-NOTHING by server/analytics.taxonomy(), desktop/main.js and tests/contracts/test_analytics_taxonomy.py. A parse failure, a missing _envelope.json or a duplicate event name across two family files yields {} — which FAILS CLOSED (validate_event drops every event) and logs once, because under fail-closed no event can ever carry the unknown_events counter out.

property_types.O: object / map keyed by an enum member

envelope.$comment: CALLER-LEGAL join keys: an emit site may pass these on any event, so validate_event() adds them to the allowed set. install_id is also the PostHog distinct_id. project_id is the PERSISTED RANDOM id from <project>/.analytics_id, never the directory slug — the slug is a sluggification of the name the user typed. fatal/handled classify an error for wall #5's crash numerator. Anything a REPORTER attaches after the gate belongs in reporter_envelope, NOT here: every name in this block is a name the renderer can put arbitrary text into via POST /api/telemetry/events, and these are all opaque ids or booleans for exactly that reason.

reporter_envelope.$comment: Names a REPORTER stamps on after validate_event() has already run. Legal on the wire on every event, but deliberately NOT in `envelope` — validate_event()'s allowed set is what a caller can send, and `os`/`arch`/`app_version` are unbounded strings that no enum gate would check (an envelope-only property has no per-event `kind`, so _enum_ok returns True and _bounded passes any top-level string). Listing them as caller-legal would hand the renderer a free-text field on every event, which is the exact hole the taxonomy exists to close. env/internal come from analytics._env_props(); app_version/os/arch/packaged from desktop/main.js's post-validation envelope; telemetry_* are the drop counters that ride out on the next successful capture. EVERY name a reporter attaches after the gate must be listed HERE — one absent from both blocks reaches the wire ungoverned, which is what a live readback caught on 10 of 11 Electron events.

reserved_substrings.$comment: analytics._scrub DESTROYS any key containing one of these — the freetext group is rewritten to '<key>_len' and the secret group to '[redacted]'. No property name in this file may contain one. Verified by contract test 3, which is why prompt_len/message_len/prompt_chars are not usable names.

open_vocabularies.os: platform.platform() / process.platform. Supplied by the OS; no user input path.
open_vocabularies.final_review_status: Produced by tools/video/video_compose, i.e. our own code.
